title: Why Hexed's Early Reviews Raise Concerns for Disney
excerpt:
Disney needs a successful original animated feature.
Early box-office projections put Hexed around $40 million.
body_md:
Disney's Thanksgiving sequels have recently delivered billion-dollar successes, while original animation has faced a less predictable market. Hexed is the studio's first non-sequel since 2023's Wish, which earned $254 million worldwide and a 48 percent critics' score.

Early reviews are mixed. Guy Lodge found the film disappointing in comparison with Wildwood, while Angie Han was more impressed by its visuals than its narrative. Amelia Emberwing welcomed its message of female empowerment. A definitive aggregate score remains premature.

Hailee Steinfeld voices Billie, a teenager discovering magical powers. Rashida Jones plays her protective mother and Jodie Foster voices Celeste. Jared Bush and Dana Ledoux Miller co-wrote the film.

A projected opening of around $40 million behind the new Hunger Games adds to the author's concerns. That figure is a forecast rather than recorded revenue. The response of the intended young audience remains unknown.

The broader question is whether Disney can build successful new properties alongside its established franchises.
